newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour has 24 point poll lead.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour has 24 point poll lead.

text.p: Britain's main opposition Labour Party has a 24-point lead over the ruling Conservatives ahead of the May 1 general election, according to an opinion poll released on Thursday.
The Harris poll for The Independent newspaper showed the Conservatives had 30 percent, up by one point from last week, while Labour was on 54 percent, down two points.
The minority Liberal Democrats were on 11 percent, a rise of one point from last week.
The poll is the latest national survey since Prime Minister John Major announced on March 17 that he would hold the election on May 1.
A MORI poll for The Times on Wednesday gave Labour a 21 point lead, while a Gallup survey for the Sunday Telegraph last weekend put Labour 25.5 points ahead.
In its survey for Friday's Independent, Harris interviewed 1,096 adults face-to-face in their homes between March 20-24.
